integrity: Exact all-size derivation in RESULT.md; independent rational enumeration over 15 finite parameter cases and a symbolic algebra check are included. Neither alone certifies historical priority or provides independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to irreversible independent-clock nearest-neighbor exclusion on KG(N,2), N >= 5, one distinguished point and positive marked-pair rate. Gives a terminal law, not time-dependent kinetics or higher-subset Kneser cases. Historical priority remains subject to unlocated papers and inaccessible full text.
title: A golden-ratio kinetic trapping window for biased adsorption on two-subset Kneser networks
